facts.business: Sri Chakra Cement Limited manufactures OPC 53/43 and PPC grade cement and operates a captive solar power generation unit.

capacity_or_capex.item: Captive solar power generation unit at Srikalahasti

guidance_or_targets.statement: The cement market in India is estimated to grow at the rate of 7-8% for the financial year 2026-27 driven by Government led infrastructure spending.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided text
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on: 1) FPPCA charges accounting treatment (total liability ₹7.08 crores), 2) Non-payment/non-provision of interest on delayed payments to MSME vendors, 3) Negative net worth of Rs. 3,523.28 lacs and current liabilities exceeding current assets by Rs. 6,975.69 lacs indicating material uncertainty on going concern.

key_risks: Heavy competition from major players adding huge capacities in and around plant area
Periodical increases in cost of inputs impacting margins
Uncertainty in coal supplies and increases in prices
Failure or deficiency in monsoon leading to reduction in cement demand
Changes in Government policy impacting costs, demand and supply
Drying up of Government contracts through irrigation, infrastructure and housing programs
High cost of power and coal, high freight costs, inadequate infrastructure, non-availability of wagons, poor quality of coal, heavy taxes/royalty levies
Climate change risks - physical and transitional
Regulatory changes driven by climate and environmental concerns
Negative net worth and current liabilities exceeding current assets indicating going concern uncertainty
facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions during FY 2025-26 were on arm's length basis and in ordinary course of business. No material related party contracts or arrangements. Disclosure in Form AOC-2 not applicable.
